terms.title: Terms & Conditions
blocks: These Terms govern access to and use of BazaarBox at bazaarbox.app and its installable web experience. By creating an account or using BazaarBox, you agree to these Terms and the policies referenced below.
## 1. Operator and contact
BazaarBox is operated in India by Deepumon Pillai, carrying on business as DMacht, at:
GHULE WASTI  MANJARI BUDRUK, PUNE  PIN 412307  MAHARASHTRA, INDIA
Support and grievance contact: hello@renewtech.solutions

ReNewTech Solutions collaborates in building BazaarBox and provides the support email service. ReNewTech Solutions is not identified by these Terms as the BazaarBox operator, contracting entity, or payment merchant.
## 2. Marketplace role

BazaarBox helps people discover, list, and discuss second-hand items available near them. BazaarBox is a local person-to-person classifieds marketplace. It is not the buyer or seller of items advertised by users.

BazaarBox does not currently provide shipping, delivery, packing, courier integration, shipping labels, fulfilment, escrow, buyer-to-seller item-payment processing, or returns logistics. Buyers and sellers arrange a local meeting, inspect the item, and complete the item transaction directly with each other.

Any fee paid to BazaarBox is only for marketplace listing access or a listing entitlement. It is not the purchase price of the advertised item and does not make BazaarBox a party to the transaction between buyer and seller.
## 3. Eligibility and accounts

You must provide accurate account information, keep access to your email and account secure, and promptly tell us if you suspect unauthorised use. You may not impersonate another person, create an account for deceptive purposes, or use another person’s account without authority.
## 4. Listings and moderation

Sellers may create a draft and submit it for moderation. A listing is not public merely because a seller has submitted it or can see it in their account. BazaarBox may approve, reject, request changes to, restrict, or remove a listing in accordance with the Posting Rules, safety requirements, applicable law, and these Terms.
Where a paid listing service is offered, publication follows approval and verification of the applicable payment or valid pack credit:
draft → moderation → approved awaiting entitlement/payment → payment or valid pack credit → publication → active for 30 days

Rejected unpublished listings ordinarily do not require payment and do not consume a listing entitlement. If a payment or pack credit is captured or reserved because of a processing race or recovery event and publication cannot occur, BazaarBox will apply the credit-restoration or refund process described in the Refund & Cancellation Policy.

BazaarBox may later remove a published listing if it violates these Terms, the Posting Rules, law, or safety requirements. Removal for a seller’s policy violation does not automatically create a refund, without limiting applicable statutory rights or a legitimate review or appeal.
## 5. Seller responsibilities
You are responsible for your listing and must:
User-generated listing descriptions may be written in any language, but BazaarBox may request clarification when needed for moderation.
## 6. Listing fees and introductory offers

The following prices describe BazaarBox listing services. A fee applies only when the applicable paid service is offered and you choose it at checkout; creating a draft does not itself authorise a charge.
### Standard listing

A standard listing entitlement is a one-time ₹10 payment for one listing active for 30 days from publication. It is not a subscription and does not renew automatically. When the 30-day publication period ends, the listing expires. Relisting requires a new entitlement and another ₹10 payment.
Ending a published listing early because the item sold or the seller changed their mind does not automatically create a refund.
### Introductory packs
Eligible verified accounts may choose one introductory promotional pack in total:

- Launch Pack: promotional price ₹50 (reference price ₹200), for up to 20 new listings; or
- Mega Launch Pack: promotional price ₹100 (reference price ₹1,000), for up to 100 new listings.

These packs are introductory offers, not subscriptions. The 30-day posting window begins after the payment provider confirms successful payment and BazaarBox grants the pack entitlement. A qualifying listing submitted or reserved during that posting window may complete moderation afterward. Each published listing receives its own 30-day publication period.
Unused and unreserved pack credits expire when the pack’s 30-day posting window ends. Credits are non-transferable, have no cash value, and cannot renew or relist an expired listing.
## 7. Payments to BazaarBox

Where BazaarBox charges a listing or promotional-pack fee, payment is processed through the payment methods made available at checkout. A listing fee is charged only when the applicable paid listing service is offered through BazaarBox. BazaarBox does not process or hold the purchase price of the advertised item.

The fee amount and currency are determined by BazaarBox’s server-side rules. A browser confirmation, redirect, screenshot, or pending provider status does not by itself grant a listing entitlement. Entitlement is granted only after BazaarBox verifies the provider result through its approved server-side process.
Refunds and cancellations are governed by the Refund & Cancellation Policy. The payment provider may also apply its own terms to the payment service it provides.
## 8. Local-meetup safety
For your safety:

If you move a conversation or transaction outside BazaarBox, we may not have the messages or information needed to investigate a problem. Moving off-platform does not remove any rights you may have under applicable law.
BazaarBox does not guarantee a buyer’s or seller’s identity, an item’s authenticity, condition or functionality, a successful sale, personal safety, or payment between buyer and seller.
## 9. Messaging, reports, and blocking

Use messaging respectfully and only for legitimate marketplace activity. Harassment, threats, fraud, spam, discrimination, and attempts to obtain passwords, OTPs, PINs, or sensitive banking information are prohibited.

Users may report listings or accounts and may block other users using available BazaarBox tools. Reports do not guarantee a particular result, but BazaarBox may investigate and take proportionate action based on available information.
## 10. Prohibited conduct
You must not:
## 11. User content

You retain responsibility for the content you submit. You confirm that you have the rights needed to provide it and that it does not violate another person’s intellectual-property, privacy, publicity, or other rights.
## 12. Availability and changes

BazaarBox is a Beta service and may change, be interrupted, contain errors, or have features added or removed. We may update these Terms prospectively. Material changes should be communicated in a reasonable way before they take effect where required by law.
## 13. Disclaimers and responsibility

BazaarBox provides marketplace discovery and communication tools. Users are responsible for evaluating listings, people, meetings, and direct item transactions. Nothing in these Terms excludes or limits rights or remedies that cannot lawfully be excluded.
## 14. Suspension and termination

BazaarBox may restrict or suspend access when reasonably necessary to address safety, fraud, abuse, policy violations, legal obligations, or risks to the service or users. Where appropriate, users may contact support to request review. Users remain responsible for obligations incurred before suspension or closure.
## 15. Contact

Questions, complaints, moderation appeals, and grievance requests may be sent to hello@renewtech.solutions. Include enough information to identify the account or listing and understand the issue, but do not email passwords, OTPs, PINs, or full payment credentials.

## 2. Information BazaarBox handles
Depending on how you use BazaarBox, we may handle:
## 3. Location information

Browser GPS is optional. If you choose Use my location, the browser provides coordinates long enough for BazaarBox to resolve a coarse public browsing location and perform a nearby search. The current design keeps raw buyer-device coordinates ephemeral: they are not placed in public URLs, rendered to other users, or intentionally persisted as a buyer-location record.
You may instead select a location or enter a PIN code. The chosen safe browsing location may be stored as a browser preference so it survives navigation or a later visit.

A seller may provide listing coordinates for proximity search. Exact seller coordinates are private and must not be returned through public listing interfaces. Public views show coarse locality information and, where available, an approximate distance.
India Post locality and PIN records are used as reference data. Location names are not guarantees of an exact address, boundary, or current postal designation.
## 4. How information is used
We use information to:
We do not use buyer GPS to infer a replacement location based on available inventory.
## 5. Public and private information

Active, approved listings may be public and may appear in search engines or social previews. Public listing information may include the title, description, price, condition, photos, seller display name, coarse locality, city, state, approximate distance, and publication information.

Your email address, authentication records, exact seller coordinates, buyer GPS coordinates, private messages, favourites, blocks, reports, moderation-only information, and sensitive support details are not intended to be public.
Do not place phone numbers, email addresses, external messaging handles, home addresses, or other private contact details in public listing fields.
## 6. Service providers and disclosures
We use service providers to run BazaarBox, including:

These providers may process information under their own contracts and privacy terms. We may also disclose information when reasonably necessary to comply with law, respond to a valid legal process, protect users or the public, investigate fraud or abuse, enforce our policies, or complete an authorised business restructuring.
We do not sell the underlying advertised item, provide escrow, or process the item purchase price between buyer and seller.
## 7. Cookies and local preferences

BazaarBox uses cookies or browser storage needed for authentication, security, language selection, install experience, and safe browsing-location preferences. The locale preference is currently stored using the bazaarbox_locale cookie.
## 8. Retention

We retain information for as long as reasonably needed to provide the service, keep the marketplace safe, resolve disputes, prevent abuse, satisfy accounting or legal obligations, and enforce agreements. Different records may require different periods. Deleted or closed-account information may remain in protected backups or legally required records for a limited period.
## 9. Security

We use technical and organisational safeguards appropriate to the service, including access controls and database policies intended to separate public, user-owned, moderator, and private data. No internet service can guarantee absolute security.
Never share your password, OTP, PIN, or sensitive banking credentials with another user. Contact us promptly if you suspect unauthorised account activity.
## 10. Your choices and requests

You may update information through available profile and listing controls. You may deny browser location access and use manual location selection instead. You may request help with access, correction, deletion, or another privacy concern by emailing hello@renewtech.solutions.

We may need to verify your identity before acting on a request. Some information may be retained where required or permitted by law, or where necessary for security, fraud prevention, dispute resolution, or the rights of others.
## 11. Children
BazaarBox is not designed to enable children to enter unsafe transactions or meetings.
## 12. Local transactions and off-platform communication

For your safety, keep conversations on BazaarBox when possible. If you move a conversation or transaction outside BazaarBox, we may not have the messages or information needed to investigate a problem. This does not remove legal rights you may have.
Buyers and sellers arrange local meetings and complete the item transaction directly. BazaarBox does not provide shipping, delivery, escrow, or buyer-to-seller item-payment processing.
## 13. Changes
We may update this Policy prospectively as BazaarBox changes or legal requirements develop. We will update the effective date and provide notice of material changes where required.
## 14. Contact and grievances

Email privacy questions or grievances to hello@renewtech.solutions or write to the operator at the address in section 1. Provide enough information to understand and respond to the request, but do not send passwords, OTPs, PINs, or full payment credentials.

refund-policy.title: Refund & Cancellation Policy
blocks: This Policy applies only to fees paid to BazaarBox for marketplace listing entitlements or promotional listing packs. It does not apply to the price of an advertised item, because buyers and sellers transact directly and BazaarBox does not process that payment.
## Cancellation before publication

You may withdraw an unpublished listing using the available listing controls or by emailing support with its reference. If no fee was collected, no refund is due. If a fee was collected for that unpublished listing and the service has not been delivered, request cancellation and a refund; BazaarBox will verify the payment and publication records. An unused pack credit reserved for the cancelled listing may be released or restored instead, subject to the pack terms and applicable law.
## Moderation rejection and cancellation after publication

A rejected unpublished listing must not consume a paid listing entitlement. If it was incorrectly charged or a credit consumed, contact support for refund or credit restoration. After publication, voluntary early removal or marking an item sold does not automatically qualify for a refund because the listing service has begun. No successful item sale is guaranteed. Statutory rights and remedies for duplicate charges or technical failures remain unaffected.
## Pack cancellation and unused credits

For cancellation of an unused promotional pack, contact support before using any credits so we can assess the purchase and any service already supplied. A partially used pack or unused credits do not automatically qualify for a refund. Unused and unreserved credits expire after the disclosed posting window; they are not automatically renewed or converted to cash. These terms do not limit statutory cancellation or refund rights.
## 1. Requesting support or a refund

Email hello@renewtech.solutions from the address associated with your BazaarBox account. Include the listing or pack, approximate payment date, provider reference if available, and a short explanation. Do not send passwords, OTPs, UPI PINs, full card numbers, or other secret payment credentials.

## 2. When a refund or credit restoration may be appropriate
Subject to verification, applicable law, and the final payment records, a refund or credit restoration may be appropriate when:

BazaarBox may restore a pack credit instead of issuing a monetary refund when that puts the account in the position it should have occupied and is appropriate under the purchase terms and applicable law.
## 3. Situations that do not automatically qualify
The following do not automatically create a refund:
This list does not limit statutory rights or prevent BazaarBox from granting an appropriate remedy after reviewing the facts.
## 4. Failed, cancelled, abandoned, or pending payments

A failed, cancelled, abandoned, or pending payment does not grant a listing entitlement. A browser redirect, screenshot, bank message, or checkout success screen is not by itself proof that BazaarBox received a successful payment.

If a payment appears debited but BazaarBox has not received a verified successful provider result, contact support. BazaarBox will compare the account and provider records and take the appropriate action. Do not make repeated payments unless the application clearly shows the previous attempt failed and the provider record has been reconciled.
## 5. Standard listings

A standard entitlement costs ₹10, covers one listing, and provides 30 days from publication. It is a one-time purchase with no automatic renewal. Relisting after expiry requires a new entitlement and payment.
## 6. Introductory promotional packs
An eligible verified account may choose one introductory pack in total:

- Launch Pack: ₹50 promotional price (reference price ₹200), up to 20 new listings; or
- Mega Launch Pack: ₹100 promotional price (reference price ₹1,000), up to 100 new listings.

The pack’s 30-day posting window begins when the payment provider confirms successful payment and BazaarBox grants the entitlement. Each qualifying listing submitted or reserved during that window may complete moderation afterward, and each published listing receives its own 30-day publication period.
Unused and unreserved credits expire with the posting window. Credits are non-transferable, cannot be exchanged for cash, and cannot renew or relist an expired listing.

Approved monetary refunds should be returned through the original payment route where supported and lawful. BazaarBox may require reasonable verification before acting. Provider or bank restrictions may affect the route or timing.

Any payment collected through BazaarBox is for BazaarBox listing/platform services only. Refund requests about the buyer-to-seller item payment must be resolved directly between buyer and seller, subject to their legal rights.

If you disagree with a decision, reply to the support response with relevant information and request review. Nothing in this Policy excludes or limits a non-waivable right or remedy under applicable law.

shipping-delivery-policy.title: No Shipping / Local Meetup Policy
blocks: BazaarBox is a local person-to-person marketplace. This policy explains how buyers and sellers arrange exchanges of advertised items.
## No shipping or delivery service

BazaarBox does not provide shipping, delivery, packing, courier or fulfillment services for marketplace items. There are no BazaarBox item-delivery timelines, courier charges or shipment-tracking promises.
## How local exchanges work
Find a nearby item → communicate through BazaarBox → arrange a safe public meetup → inspect the item → buyer and seller complete their transaction directly.
Meet in a busy, well-lit public place, inspect the actual item and confirm its condition before paying the seller. Avoid advance deposits to strangers. Never share passwords, OTPs or PINs.
## Item payments and platform fees

BazaarBox does not process or hold the purchase price of the advertised item. Any BazaarBox listing/platform fee is separate from the buyer/seller transaction and pays only for the applicable platform service.

BazaarBox is not the seller of the advertised merchandise and does not provide escrow, delivery guarantees or item-return logistics. Buyers and sellers must address item-sale disputes directly, subject to their legal rights.
## Problems and support

Report suspected fraud or prohibited content using the marketplace reporting tools or email hello@renewtech.solutions. For immediate danger, leave the situation and contact the appropriate emergency authorities. Refunds of BazaarBox platform fees are covered by the Refund & Cancellation Policy.

safety.title: Safety & Posting Rules
blocks: These Rules apply to listings and marketplace conduct on BazaarBox. They supplement the Terms of Use and are designed for local person-to-person resale.
## 1. Offer a real item you may sell

- List only an item you own or are authorised to sell.
- BazaarBox listings are offers to sell, not wanted-to-buy advertisements.
- Do not list stolen, counterfeit, recalled, unsafe, illegal, or prohibited items.
- Do not list an item that is no longer available.
## 2. Describe the item accurately

- Use the correct category.
- Write an accurate title and description.
- State the actual asking price. Do not use an unrealistic or misleading price to attract views.
- Select the condition that best describes the item.
- Disclose known defects, damage, missing parts, repairs, locked features, and material limits on functionality.
- Do not claim authenticity, specifications, ownership history, warranty, or performance that you cannot substantiate.
- User-written descriptions may be in any language. BazaarBox may request clarification where needed for moderation.
## 3. Use genuine photos

- Upload actual photos of the item being offered.
- You may upload a maximum of four listing photos.
- Choose a clear cover photo and show important condition details.
- Do not use another seller’s images, misleading stock images, watermarks that obscure the item, or images containing prohibited or unrelated content.
## 4. One honest listing

- Do not create duplicate or substantially similar active listings for the same item.
- Do not repost across cities, localities, PIN codes, or categories to manipulate discovery or evade rules, moderation, entitlement limits, or fees.
- When an item is sold or unavailable, mark or close the listing promptly.
- Where a paid listing service is offered, relisting an expired listing requires a new entitlement.
## 5. Keep contact information private

Do not include phone numbers, email addresses, home addresses, external messaging handles, social accounts, payment identifiers, or other direct contact details in public listing titles, descriptions, photos, or other public fields.

For your safety, keep initial conversations on BazaarBox when possible. If you move a conversation or transaction outside BazaarBox, we may not have the messages or information needed to investigate a problem. Moving off-platform does not remove legal rights you may have.
## 6. Local meetup only

BazaarBox currently supports local person-to-person discovery and meetups. BazaarBox does not provide shipping, delivery, packing, courier integration, shipping labels, fulfilment, escrow, or buyer-to-seller item-payment processing.
Do not represent BazaarBox as a shipping provider, payment guarantor, escrow service, authenticator, or party to the item transaction.
## 7. Meet safely

- Meet in a busy, well-lit public place.
- Meet during reasonable hours where possible.
- Tell a trusted person where you are going.
- Avoid isolated or private locations, especially for a first meeting.
- Inspect the actual item and verify its condition and functionality before completing the transaction.
- Avoid advance deposits to strangers.
- Never share passwords, OTPs, PINs, or sensitive banking credentials.
- Leave if anything feels unsafe.
- Contact the appropriate local emergency authorities if there is immediate danger.
BazaarBox does not guarantee a buyer’s or seller’s identity, item authenticity, item condition, a successful sale, personal safety, or payment between buyer and seller.
## 8. Prohibited and restricted listings
The following are prohibited in the current BazaarBox marketplace:
This list is not exhaustive. BazaarBox may refuse an item that presents legal, safety, fraud, or platform-integrity risk even if it is not listed above.
## 9. Moderation and enforcement

Submitting a listing does not make it public. BazaarBox may approve, reject, request changes to, restrict, or remove a listing. A rejected unpublished listing ordinarily does not consume a listing entitlement. A listing published after approval may still be removed if later information shows a violation.

Actions may include a warning, required correction, reduced visibility, rejection, removal, account restriction, or suspension. BazaarBox should consider available evidence, severity, repetition, safety, and applicable law. Users may contact hello@renewtech.solutions to request review.
Removal for a seller’s policy violation does not automatically create a refund, without limiting statutory rights or an appropriate appeal.
## 10. Reporting concerns

Use the available report tools for suspected fraud, prohibited content, harassment, or safety concerns. For immediate danger, leave the situation and contact the appropriate local emergency authorities. Do not use reports to harass another user or manipulate competition.
## 11. Contact
Questions about these Rules, listing moderation, or an appeal may be sent to hello@renewtech.solutions.
